name: Block Forge
description: End-to-end workflow that creates a block from a description, tests it against a contract, iterates until it passes, and publishes the result. Orchestrates test-designer and agent-creator agents.

end-to-end-creation.description: From a description and target contract to a published block

tests.description: Creates a block from a natural language description
tests.prompt: Create a code-reviewer agent that implements the code-reviewer contract. It should review code for bugs, style issues, and suggest improvements.
Start creating a commit-message-writer block in a new workspace

tests.description: Published block is available in the catalog
tests.prompt: The block passed all tests. Publish it to the catalog.

tests.description: Workflow writes the block definition to disk
tests.prompt: Create a simple greeting agent that implements the greeting contract. Write the block.json file.

contract-compliance.description: Created blocks pass the tests defined in their target contract

tests.description: Runs the target contract's tests against the created block
tests.prompt: After creating the code-reviewer block, verify it passes the code-reviewer contract tests

tests.description: When tests fail, improves the block and retries
tests.prompt: The code-reviewer block failed the 'review-quality' test. The response didn't contain 'suggestion'. What should the forge do next?

tests.description: Workflow runs contract tests to verify the block
tests.prompt: You just created a greeting agent block. Now test it against the greeting contract to check if it passes.

adaptation.description: Create variants of a block for different models

tests.description: Creates a variant targeting a different model
tests.prompt: Create a haiku variant of the code-reviewer block that currently runs on opus

tests.description: Variant is tested against the same contract
tests.prompt: After creating the haiku variant, how do you verify it still meets the contract?

scoring.description: Score = sum(feature.weight * feature.score). Block forge must reliably produce contract-compliant blocks through end-to-end automation.
